name: Beef Tenderloin (Filet Mignon)
siboNotes: Plain beef is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO. Choose simple cooking methods and avoid high-FODMAP marinades or seasonings.
preparationTips: Season with low-FODMAP herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Cook with simple methods: grilling, pan-searing, or roasting
Avoid marinades containing onion, garlic, or high-FODMAP ingredients
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of B vitamins, especially B12
